highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: This release supersedes the 4.147.x previews and lands all v4 changes cumulatively: variable font and color palette support, animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData for zero-copy I/O, and a rewritten singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — see the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

breaking.title: `new SKFont()` now uses an empty typeface (no lazy default)
breaking.body: Upstream Skia m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs), so `MeasureText` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Pass an explicit typeface: `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)`. Detect the unset state with `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `font.Typeface == null`.

breaking.title: `new SKPaint().Typeface` returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null
breaking.body: Text measurement and drawing still work out of the box — SkiaSharp seeds the default font — but `paint.Typeface == null` no longer fires. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` or drop the check (a usable default is always present).

breaking.title: `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing")` returns Default instead of null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now return `SKTypeface.Default` for an unknown family (Android used to return null). For strict null semantics, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)` which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: `SKStream.Move(long)` now throws `OverflowException` and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. The `Move(long)` overload now uses a checked cast and is marked `[Obsolete]`. Call `Move(int)` instead, validating or clamping large values first. Most callers only need the obsolete-warning fix.

breaking.title: Vulkan 1.0 now aborts the process instead of returning null from `GRContext.CreateVulkan`
breaking.body: Skia Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. A Vulkan 1.0 instance or a `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` of 0 causes Skia to call `SK_ABORT` — the process terminates. Set `apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1` in your `VkApplicationInfo` and set `MaxAPIVersion` on `GRVkBackendContext` to the same value.

breaking.title: `GRVkBackendContextNative` — five interop fields removed
breaking.body: Removed: `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments. Use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`.

breaking.title: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` retyped; `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` loses value-equality
breaking.body: The property type changed from `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. The old struct no longer implements `IEquatable` or equality operators. Update code that compared values or matched the old type name.

breaking.title: `SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter on `IgnorePublicDispose` has been removed. Subclasses that wrote to it must be updated; the property is now get-only.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to errors; obsolete enums trimmed
breaking.body: All APIs that were `[Obsolete]` warnings in 3.x — including the SKPaint text/font members — are now errors in 4.x and removed from the ref assembly. Remove all `#pragma warning disable CS0618` suppressions and migrate to the replacement APIs.

bullets.lead: Skia upgraded from m132/m147 through to m148
bullets.detail: The Skia engine was bumped through milestones 132, 133, 147, and finally 148, delivering Skia's latest rendering engine improvements, including several upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color palette support
bullets.detail: Full variable font axis support and color font palette APIs are now available in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, enabling OpenType `fvar`/`HVAR` fonts and COLRv1 color palettes.
A new `SKWebpEncoder` API allows encoding multi-frame animated WebP files from C#.
A new `SKStream.GetData()` method wraps the native stream contents as an `SKData` without copying, useful for efficiently accessing encoded image bytes.
Both surface-drawing methods now accept an `SKSamplingOptions` argument, giving fine-grained control over resampling quality.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp gains `HBColor` struct and missing API wrappers
bullets.detail: A dedicated `HBColor` struct now correctly represents `hb_color_t`, and several missing HarfBuzz wrappers and naming-convention fixes have been added.
Native assets for Linux Bionic (Android-flavored Linux used in some embedded and ChromeOS contexts) are now included in the NuGet package.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added
bullets.detail: The Tizen platform now ships x64 and arm64 native binaries in addition to the existing arm build.

`GetPixelSpan` now correctly uses `RowBytes` for stride instead of `Width × BytesPerPixel`, fixing corruption on images with padding. A related off-by-one in `GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y)` that used Height instead of Width for the offset is also fixed.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalizer crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first
bullets.detail: A use-after-free in the finalizer thread, where an `SKPath` outlived its underlying `SKPathBuilder`, is fixed.
On Android API 36+ the font manager could return null for `matchFamilyStyle(null, Normal)`, crashing on access. The fallback now yields `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of throwing.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: Consumers of WinUI / WinAppSDK on .NET 9 no longer see a DLL-not-found error at startup.

bullets.lead: Android `SKGLView` rendering after MAUI TabBar tab switch fixed
bullets.detail: A long-standing issue where the GL view stopped rendering after switching tabs in a MAUI `TabBar` on Android has been resolved.

bullets.lead: Apple platform TFMs corrected: 26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps
bullets.detail: Library TFMs now use the versioned `net9.0-ios26.0` form while app TFMs use the unversioned `net9.0-ios` form, matching Apple's framework conventions.

The `SKObject` singleton registry has been redesigned to be re-entrant and thread-safe, eliminating races and crashes seen when singletons (e.g., `SKColorSpace.Srgb`) were accessed from multiple threads or after disposal.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved from `[ModuleInitializer]` to `SkiaApi` cctor
bullets.detail: The startup version check that guards against binary incompatibility now runs in the `SkiaApi` class constructor, making it compatible with trimming and AOT scenarios that strip module initializers.

bullets.lead: Warnings-as-errors enabled across all binding projects
bullets.detail: All C# warnings in `binding/` are now treated as errors, and pre-existing warnings have been resolved, ensuring clean builds going forward.

bullets.lead: Native dependency updates: libpng, libexpat, freetype, libjpeg-turbo, zlib, HarfBuzz
bullets.detail: libpng was updated to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5 (and later 2.8.1), freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, and zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley — picking up security and bug fixes across all bundled native libraries. HarfBuzz was updated to 14.2.0.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped Skia through milestones 132 and 147, added variable font support, reworked the singleton lifecycle, fixed the SKPath finalizer crash, promoted SKPaint text/font obsoletes to errors, and updated SkiaSharpGenerator to CppAst 0.21.4.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native asset support and C# 13 PolySharp polyfill support for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate landed the Skia m148 upgrade, the singleton lifecycle rework, SKPixmap stride fixes, the WinUI .NET 9 fix, and the final rounds of obsolete-API promotion and native dependency updates.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData, HarfBuzz 14.2.0, Apple 26.0 TFM corrections, and several upstream m147 bug-fix syncs.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced variable font axis support and color palette APIs in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, HBColor, missing HarfBuzz API wrappers, and Linux Bionic native assets.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 bumped the engine to Skia m147, added Tizen x64/arm64 native builds, fixed the Android default-typeface crash, and enabled warnings-as-errors across all binding projects.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships with this release, adding variable font axis support, color palette APIs, and the new `HBColor` struct for correct `hb_color_t` representation.
